w: At 11.40 pm the moment Swamishri arrived near the mandir, a small welcome procession burst with the sound of brass band, and traditionally dressed drummers and dancing children.

After Thakorji's darshan and welcoming ceremony, Swamishri elaborated upon the theme that we do not wish to go to Akshardham because we are comfortable with the worldly life. Swamishri narrated the story of the worm and the bee and then midway included the story of the king and his ailing queen (formally a beggar). Then Swamishri narrated the incident of Jodho Bharvad who was unhappy with the boiling of milk... In concluding, Swamishri said, "We have been blessed with Satsang, God and the holy sadhu, so there is no need to search for them anywhere else. There is no need to allow our mind to stray in superstitions. Happiness and liberation lies here..."

John's Devotion While Swamishri was having lunch, John was sitting in an uncomfortable posture because of lack of space. Perceiving this Swamishri told everyone to come forward a little. Then Swamishri asked John, "Now, are you all right!" John said yes. Later, when John came to meet Swamishri someone introduced him, saying, "John was attracted to Satsang through a festival in the mandir. Despite his inability to understand Gujarati, both he and his wife regularly attend the Sunday assembly. His wife is at present engaged in seva with the other women devotees. "Once, to attend your puja in London John got up at 2 am and drove to London." Swamishri was immensely pleased at his devotion and blessed him.

Freedom from Fear A person troubled with a fear came up to Swamishri. He said that a Brahmin had told him that his son had 'kal-sarp dosh' in his horoscope. "My son will suffer from some physical problem," he said. Swamishri replied, "Don't get entangled in such superstitions. Say the holy name of Swaminarayan. The body is susceptible to disease. Even I have stomach aches and fever. So there is no need to be fearful or superstitious. Engage yourself in bhajan and all will be well." Swamishri unshackled him from blind faith and superstition and inspired him with faith in God.

Swamishri arrived in Pachmarhi for a 3½ day satsang shibir (21 (evening) to 24 (afternoon) ) for the devotees of Madhya Pradesh and Maharashtra. The three-tier shibir, with limited invitations, comprised of 75 Balaks-Balikas, 151 Kishores-Kishoris and 432 senior devotees. Swamishri and senior sadhus offered valuable spiritual guidance and inspiration.
On seeing two veteran devotees from the time of Shastriji Maharaj, Swamishri called them, "Come here. You are old in Satsang. Do you come to the mandir?"
Jagdishbhai replied, "I come everyday."
A local sadhu added, "He does not come to the satsang assembly."
Swamishri responded, "Do you remember that Yogiji Maharaj once massaged your feet!"
Jagdishbhai said, "I come since you have instructed me."
Swamishri explained, "It is Yogiji Maharaj's command to attend the Sunday assembly."
The local sadhu clarified his statement, "He comes to the Sunday assembly but he does not attend the weekly suburb assembly."

Swamishri replied, "If the circumstances permit you should attend your local area assembly, but you must attend the Sunday assembly. You will have the darshan of Thakorji, meet the sadhus, ... If you obey this command, you will experienced peace."
Then Swamishri added, "It is because that I have love for you that I am telling you. Forgive me for saying it emphatically."
Both the devotees replied with folded hands, "Swamishri, you have the right to tell us."
Often, Swamishri expresses his care and concern for the spiritual progress of devotees by telling them to attend the Sunday assembly.

Karyarkar Din In the evening assembly, Swamishri was honored with a citation by the local leader of the Muslim Community, Mr Kadri. Then the Mayor of Gardena City, Terence Terauchi, honored Swamishri with a Certificate of Welcome and the Council Member of Norvek City, Mr Rick Ramirez, presented a Key to the City to Swamishri.

June 22 Satsang Assembly
June 23 Satsang Assembly

In the evening assembly, after Viveksagar Swami’s discourse, a drama, “Servants of Satsang” was enacted by youths. The central theme of the drama was how BAPS volunteers, amidst their personal worldly responsibilities, inspire satsang in others despite difficulties and insults. Finally Swamishri blessed the assembly, “We have attained the association of Shriji Maharaj, Shastriji Maharaj and Yogiji Maharaj, which is a great thing. This is not possible even if we take so many births. So we should remain steadfast in one’s resolve to please God no matter how much pain or misery comes our way.” In the following days the evening assemblies were celebrated on the theme of Mandir Day and Vicharan Day.

A non-devotee came to seek Swamishri’s counsel to alleviate his anger. He described that since the last ten years his nature had become prone to angry outbursts because of his failing business. Once when his wife asked him to purchase some household needs he flared up. Though the matter was very small he pressed his wife’s throat. The man broke down at this point. “I was lucky that my wife survived, because I had pressed her throat to such an extent that she would have died. Later I regretted and repented for what I had done. Whatever that happened was because of the declining state of my business.”

Swamishri advised him, “No matter what happens do not get angry. If you have problems regarding your business then keep them there, but don’t bring them home. Because of your business problems why should you press your wife’s throat? Where is her fault? When she needs household things then who would she tell? Therefore never ever do this again.” The man expressed his frustration further, “But all the failures I have gone through in the past keep haunting me. I cannot concentrate for even an hour. In that hour the past straddles my mind.”
Swamishri advised, “Try to forget all that. Have faith in God and do bhajan. Say Swaminarayan, Swaminarayan, and you’ll be fine.”
Swamishri inspired hope with practical solutions and having faith in God.

After the morning puja today, Mahant Swami Maharaj showered blessings: "If someone told you to sleep in a big dustbin, how would you enjoy it? Lust, anger, arrogance and jealousy are just like that, and we revel in them; how can happiness come? If there is humility, seeing divinity, understanding of glory and so on, there is happiness for us and happiness for everyone. And if there is ego, there is misery for us and misery for everyone. From humility many other virtues spring. It is the father of all values."

Today Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the VIP lounge at the airport to go to America. Nilkanthjivandas Swami, who serves Thakorji, asked, "We are only going to America, and there is so much checking. So how much checking will there be to go to Akshardham?"
Showing the luminous path to Akshardham, Swamishri said, "Refuge..."

ds.p: On the flight from London to Atlanta
w: Sensing that the time was right, Gunkirtandas Swami and Roshan began a question and answer session with Mahant Swami Maharaj.

Gunkirtandas Swami: "After puja, before and after you read the Dharmamrut, you have darshan with great feeling of the murtis of Shriji Maharaj and Shastriji Maharaj on its cover. What do you think at that time?"
Swamishri: "How compassionate; how great a compassion he has shown us, how much grace!"
Roshan: "You went to Anand station and met Yogi Bapa, and you kept remembering that incident. How should we remember, so that both the murti and the incident stay in our memory?"
Swamishri: "Remember an incident that is striking (that has touched you)."
Gunkirtandas Swami: "We have so much darshan, and if we try to write everything, the important things get left out."
Swamishri: "Then you will not even read it. So write down and remember the incidents that were striking. Even if there is only one a week, it does not matter; write those."
Roshan: "What should we do to remember well? A memory that stays... through prayer? Through thinking of the glory?"
Swamishri: "Do both. Pray and think of the glory."
Swamishri not only gives memories but also teaches the way to fix those memories permanently in the heart.

ds.t: A dry patch in the rain
w: Today there was an 85% forecast of rain. When Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the podium at the Atlanta mandir, it was raining all around, just five minutes away from here, but not here. Everyone saw Swamishri's power, because before Swamishri's arrival in Atlanta it had been raining heavily, but as he was leaving London, Swamishri had blessed them on the phone, saying, "It will be fine... it will be dry." And that is exactly what was experienced here.
It was raining everywhere around. It was as if Swamishri had held a huge invisible umbrella in the sky over the mandir and kept that area free of rain.
